name: content_background_existence_v1

generation.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, camera motion, cuts, multiple objects, flicker

cases.prompt: locked camera, a single red tram moving slowly along a straight empty city street, stable daylight, no people, no cuts
locked camera, a single yellow sailboat drifting slowly across a quiet lake, stable morning light, no people, no cuts
locked camera, a single brown horse walking slowly across a flat grassy field, stable cloudy light, no people, no cuts
locked camera, a single silver sedan moving slowly along a straight empty country road, stable overcast daylight, no people, no cuts
locked camera, a single purple canoe gliding slowly across a calm river, stable afternoon light, no people, no cuts
locked camera, a single turquoise cargo truck moving slowly along a straight empty road, stable daylight, no people, no cuts
locked camera, a single black dog walking slowly across an empty park lawn, stable cloudy light, no people, no cuts
locked camera, a single orange tractor moving slowly across a flat harvested field, stable morning light, no people, no cuts

control.meaning: cumulative native response RMS: SINGLE46 full amount; MULTI44/46 equal halves

calibration.rule: per receiver: maximum over three fixed views for each of four calibration OFF sources, then maximum across sources plus guard
calibration.claim: functional independent-OFF calibration only; no low-FPR claim

evidence_ceiling: fixed new-source user-run validation with retained failures; no low-FPR, generalization, quality, capacity, or causal background-removal claim
